Are you looking for a role where you can go beyond reporting and truly influence the way a business operates?Our client is a company with a strong local footprint and the backing of a leading international group. Operating in a traditional, relationship-driven environment, the company is now entering a phase of modernization, process improvement, and organizational development.To support this journey, we are looking for a Finance Business Partner who will act as a trusted advisor to the business, a key contact for all departments, and the right hand to the Finance Director.This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys autonomy, likes to challenge the status quo, and wants to play a central role in driving continuous improvement.

Jobomschrijving

As Finance Business Partner, you will work closely with both operational and management teams, providing financial insights that support strategic and day-to-day decision-making.You will be expected to bring structure, improve ways of working, and help the business evolve towards more efficient processes and tools.Key Responsibilities

• Act as the main finance point of contact for all business departments.
• Partner with operational managers to support decision-making and improve business performance.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
• Deliver meaningful reporting and performance analysis to management.
• Identify opportunities to enhance financial and operational processes.
• Drive improvements in reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence capabilities.
• Support the implementation of more efficient ways of working across the organization.
• Work on strategic and ad hoc projects alongside the Finance Director.
• Build bridges between finance and operations, ensuring financial insights are translated into actionable business recommendations.
• Contribute to the long-term professionalization and structuring of the finance function.

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of experience in Controlling, Finance Business Partnering, or a similar finance role.
• Strong analytical skills combined with a pragmatic and hands-on mindset.
• Comfortable working in an environment where not everything is already structured.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Genuine interest in process optimization and business improvement.
• Advanced Excel skills and experience with SAP and reporting tools.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are looking for an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to strengthen our teams.Your role:

• As an Information Systems Security Manager, you protect the organization's information and digital assets against cyber threats by implementing the Safran Information Systems Security Policy.
• You will report to the Information Systems & Digital Transformation Director.
• You will implement the Safran Information Systems Security Policy within the subsidiary.
• As a member of the SAE and Safran ISSM community, you participate in its activities and act as the local representative at SAESB.
• You manage risks and compliance:
• You verify hardware and software compliance and monitor the execution of remediation plans.
• You drive regulatory compliance (GDPR, NIS2, Part-IS, etc.) and conduct cyber risk assessments.
• You coordinate responses to security incidents in collaboration with SAE and Safran.
• You test the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).
• You lead cybersecurity awareness and training programs to strengthen the company's cybersecurity culture.

Your profile:
 
 

• 3 to 5 years of experience as an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM/CISO) within a company of more than 100 employees. 

• Experience in an industrial environment is an asset. 

• Good technical knowledge of IT and cloud architectures and infrastructures. 

• Knowledge of operational security and detection components (SOC, SIEM, EDR protection tools, etc.). 

• Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO 27001), regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, EASA Part-IS), and risk analysis methodologies. 

• Strong team spirit and ability to work collaboratively. 

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. 

• Ability to manage stress and urgent situations. 

• Organized, rigorous, autonomous, and accountable. 

• Fluency in French and English, good Dutch.  

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For a butcher's shop in the Ghent region, we are looking for a butcher to strengthen the team.

What will you do?

• Skilfully cut meat and process it into sausages, minced meat and other specialities.
• Restock the counter and present products in an attractive way.
• Keep the workstation, tools and equipment clean and safe.
• Package food products correctly in accordance with food safety standards.

Who are you?

• You have completed a butcher's training programme.
• Diploma in hand, but no relevant work experience yet? No problem, as you will be very well supported by your team.
• You speak Dutch, English or French.
• You are accurate and work hygienically.

• Our client is an established property developer expanding its residential portfolio in Luxembourg, with a focus on well-designed, energy-efficient homes.
• Its local team combines an entrepreneurial working environment with the expertise and resources of a wider development group.
• Working closely with local management, you will have direct involvement in sales activity and the opportunity to contribute ideas that support commercial growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive sales across a portfolio of residential developments, advising both owner-occupiers and property investors.
• Understand buyers' priorities, budgets and investment objectives to recommend suitable properties.
• Convert enquiries into qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting, consistent follow-up and personalised advice.
• Lead property viewings, project presentations and sales meetings, guiding clients through the purchasing process.
• Build referral relationships with local agents, notaries, investors and other property professionals.
• Coordinate with marketing on lead generation, campaigns and events to support sales conversion.
• Monitor market trends, buyer demand and competing developments to identify commercial opportunities.
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline records and performance reporting.
• Depending on your experience and interests, contribute to partnerships and the identification of potential development acquisitions.

• At least three years of relevant real estate sales experience, preferably involving new-build residential property.
• A sound understanding of the Luxembourg property market; an existing local network would be an advantage.
• Excellent French and professional working proficiency in English. Luxembourgish, German or Dutch would be an asset.
• The ability to tailor your advice to both lifestyle-driven buyers and investment-focused clients.
• A proactive approach to prospecting, supported by commercial drive and disciplined follow-through.
• Professional communication, discretion and the ability to build trust throughout a significant purchasing decision.
• Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with management and marketing.
• An interest in developing your contribution beyond individual property transactions.

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

jobs.description:
• Our client is a leading international manufacturer operating within the chemicals and consumer products industry, combining the agility of a medium-sized local production site operating in a SEVESO environment with the resources, expertise and career opportunities of a global organisation.

Jobomschrijving

• Define and implement the site HSE strategy in line with Group standards and objectives.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian health, safety and environmental regulations.
• Lead the HSE management system and oversee ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 compliance.

Our client is a well-established organization active in a technical and service-oriented environment, delivering complex products and solutions to a diverse customer base.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and optimize warehouse, logistics, service, and installation operations to ensure high performance and operational excellence.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across inventory management, order fulfillment, workforce planning, and productivity.
• Oversee the planning, coordination, and successful delivery of standard and project-based installations, ensuring deadlines, budgets, and quality standards are met.
• Manage operational performance, budgets, and cost-control initiatives while identifying opportunities for efficiency gains.
• Lead, coach, and develop operational teams and managers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in operations management within a technical, industrial, logistics, or service-driven environment.
• Strong leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and building high-performing organizations.
• Solid expertise in warehouse management, logistics, service operations, project coordination, and operational excellence methodologies.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, combined with experience in budget management and cost control.
• Hands-on and results-oriented leadership style, with excellent communication skills and the ability to successfully lead change and transformation initiatives.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a well-established service provider active in industrial maintenance.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage daily site operations and coordinate multiple ongoing projects across various industrial locations.
• Lead, coach, and organize blue-collar teams to ensure productivity, quality, and compliance with safety standards.
• Oversee planning, resource allocation, workforce scheduling, and operational execution.
• Monitor project performance, budgets, and operational KPIs, identifying opportunities for improvement and cost control.
• Drive a strong safety culture and ensure the implementation of all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

• Masters Degree in Industrial, Electromechanical engineering, or relevant technical background.
• Proven experience as a Site Manager, Project Manager, Operations Manager, or similar leadership role within industrial services, construction, maintenance, or related sectors.

• Solid organizational and planning capabilities, combined with a structured and hands-on management approach.
• Experience managing budgets, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.

• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.

Do you combine deep Microsoft security expertise with architectural judgement to turn complex requirements into secure, scalable and supportable solutions? As Security Solution Architect – Microsoft Security, part of our Security & Networking Architecture team, you are a senior, customer-facing technical authority for the Microsoft security domain. You own solution architecture and design authority from discovery through delivery, translating business, risk and security requirements into integrated architectures across Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid environments. Your scope spans Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview. You collaborate closely with the Cegeka Modern SOC, which supports the Microsoft security stack. You work directly on customer engagements and provide specialist architecture expertise to opportunities led by the Solution Pre-Sales team.

 

• You lead customer discovery, architecture workshops and technical decision forums to assess Microsoft security maturity and clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and risks.
• Design integrated Zero Trust architectures using Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel and Purview, with Intune and Azure networking controls where relevant.
• Act as design authority for Microsoft security solutions: define high-level designs, integration patterns and security standards; review solution artefacts; and govern exceptions, technical debt and architectural trade-offs.
• Guide engineering and project teams through implementation and migration. Validate detailed designs, configuration baselines and runbooks. Agree onboarding and acceptance criteria with the Cegeka Modern SOC, including detection and response workflows, access and escalation paths, and confirm readiness for operational handover.
• Address security, integration and operational risks through least privilege, identity governance, segmentation, data protection and resilience. Define telemetry, automation and integration requirements with the Cegeka Modern SOC across Microsoft and third-party platforms, with clear ownership of control management and incident response.
• Provide validated Microsoft security architecture inputs to the Solution Pre-Sales team, including solution options, licensing prerequisites, consumption and delivery estimates, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
• Partner with Product Management and the Cegeka Modern SOC to evolve Microsoft security services, reference architectures, blueprints and costing models. Use operational feedback and incident lessons to improve designs and translate platform developments into supportable customer propositions.
• Maintain reusable Microsoft security architecture assets, coach colleagues and contribute to Microsoft technology-partner relationships. Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI security, against customer needs and operational constraints.
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft security solutions, with senior-level architectural credibility and the ability to lead customer-facing technical discussions.
• Deep hands-on expertise in at least one Microsoft security pillar—Entra identity and access, Defender threat protection, Sentinel security operations, Defender for Cloud, or Purview data security—with architectural understanding across the wider portfolio.
• Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management with Intune, networking and workload security, including integration with non-Microsoft technologies.
• Experience collaborating with SOC and managed services teams on monitoring, response, onboarding and operational handover.
• Demonstrated ability to translate requirements into integrated high-level designs, govern technical decisions and review detailed designs, migration plans, security baselines and operational documentation. Practical familiarity with KQL, PowerShell or infrastructure-as-code is an asset.
• Experience supporting dedicated presales teams with Microsoft security solution options, licensing and consumption considerations, effort and cost inputs, dependencies and risks.
• You can explain technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong architectural thinking, technical leadership, consulting, communication and collaboration skills. You balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer risk, existing investments, commercial constraints and supportability.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.
• Microsoft security certifications or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, infrastructure or architecture.

We are Team possible – the people behind Davinsi Labs, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones: 

• AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault
• HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
• Ansible
• Microsoft Entra ID
• Microsoft Azure
• PingIdentity PingOne for customers
• Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities: 

• Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
• Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
• Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
• Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation. 

Your profile

 Hello, is it me you're looking for? 

• You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
• Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
• Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
• You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
• You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.

Wat ga je doen?                
Rijd regionale distributieritten en lever goederen veilig en punctueel af met oog voor klanttevredenheid.Als CE chauffeur bij onze klant verzorg je regionale distributieritten en lever je goederen veilig en nauwkeurig af aan diverse klanten. Je werkt met een vaste vrachtwagen vanuit Desteldonk en hebt dagelijks contact met een planningsteam dat zorgt voor een duidelijke structuur. Veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en klantgerichtheid staan centraal in jouw werk.- Je voert regionale of nationale distributieritten uit voor verschillende klanten.- Je vertrekt elke dag vanuit Desteldonk met een vaste vrachtwagen.- Je transporteert goederen veilig en professioneel.- Je volgt het dagschema en zorgt voor stipte leveringen.- Je communiceert op een vriendelijke en professionele manier met klanten.- Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je routes en materiaal.- Je krijgt ondersteuning van het planningsteam en de HR-afdeling.- Je ontvangt interne opleidingen en begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en coaches.Je werkt van maandag tot vrijdag en start dagelijks tussen 4:00 en 6:00 uur, afhankelijk van je ritplanning.Zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer vandaag nog — we kijken uit naar je reactie!
                Wie ben jij?                                                                                        
• You are customer-oriented and punctual.                                                                                                
• You take responsibility while on the road.                                                                                                
• You have a flexible and professional attitude.                                                                                                
• You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.                                                                                                
• You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.                                                                                                
Opleiding: No specific diploma required.
                                                    
Vakkennis: Experience as a driver or in distribution transport is an advantage, but not required.
                                                    
Talenkennis: You speak Dutch, French or English.
                                                    
Attesten: Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.
                                Wat bieden wij jou?                                                                                        
• You receive personal guidance, clear agreements and opportunities to further develop yourself.                                                                                                
• You receive an attractive salary based on your experience.                                                                                                
• A meal allowance of €9 per day worked.                                                                                                
• A dedicated truck that you use to depart from Desteldonk every day.                                                                                                
• A company car after six months, which you may also use for private purposes.                                                            
.

Voor onze relatie in Antwerpen zijn wij dringend op zoek naar een 1e lijns support engineer.

Provide first-line IT support to colleagues worldwide and act as an escalation point for other IT service agents across our global network.
 

Troubleshoot incidents and technical issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware, networks, servers and internally developed applications.
 

Manage the lifecycle of end-user devices, including installation, configuration, maintenance and replacement.

Register, manage and follow up on incidents and service requests through our ticketing system, ensuring accurate worklogs.

jobs.occupation: Cloud DataOps Platform Engineer - Data & AI
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on projects, are you a true Microsoft Azure DevOps specialist and do you provide the right Microsoft Cloud Infrastructure solutions for our customers? Do you like to bridge the gap between operations and development? Then Cegeka's rapidly growing and passionate Data & AI team has an interesting challenge for you! We are looking for a Cloud DataOps Platform Engineer, a crucial role in modern data-driven organisations where scalability, reliability and automation are key.

 

• You are a driving force for further developing the DevOps culture within our Data & AI team. This means that you contribute to best practices regarding automation, version control, releases, infrastructure, security, etc. Thanks to your coaching style, you know how to lift other project members to a higher level.
• You build and manage data platforms that run analytics, AI and ML.
• You are responsible for setting up, maintaining and automating cloud environments using IaC tools such as Terraform and Bicep.
• You develop, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data-related applications in Azure.
• You will automate data pipelines (ETL/ELT).
• You will be responsible for integrating services such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.
• You will configure and manage Azure infrastructure for data applications, including Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL Database, and others.

Change Manager - Facilities Transformation
We are looking for a medior change Manager to support the launch of a Facilities transformation programme covering activities across both headquarters and branches. The scope is broad and includes areas such as building maintenance, procurement and sales. You do not need to be a Facilities or building-sector expert; the key is to understand the context quickly and help people make sense of what is changing.

Working closely with the Head of Change & Transformation, Facilities project managers and key stakeholders, you will help challenge, structure and deliver the change approach. You will contribute to important programme milestones and support teams in understanding how Facilities activities operate today and how they may evolve in the future.

Your responsibilities will include preparing and facilitating presentations and workshops, contributing to training materials and communications, and helping draft content for works councils. You will map current ways of working (As Is) and support the design of future processes and ways of working (To Be), particularly for major transformation initiatives. You will also help make complex or technical topics clear, accessible and relevant to different audiences.

The role involves working with teams across four Facilities subdomains, representing around 200 people. Process-mapping and future-state discussions will mainly be held with a smaller group of approximately four to six key stakeholders. You will facilitate these discussions, gather relevant insights and help translate them into a clear view of the future journey and operating model. Depending on programme needs, you may also contribute to the preparation of an RFP.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable facilitating groups, structuring ideas and communicating with a range of stakeholders. You should be able to get up to speed quickly in a new environment, take a practical and collaborative approach, and explain change in straightforward terms. Experience in change management, workshop facilitation and process mapping is important. This could suit someone who is keen to build their experience in change management and appreciates working in a supportive, well-guided team.

Fluency in French or Dutch is required, together with a good understanding of the other national language. Good written English is also needed, particularly for preparing emails and presentations. Specific experience in Facilities, buildings or maintenance is not required.
